design: Replay source factorial; capture actual L2 post-normalization/RoPE Q,K,Q2,K2 and mixedV. Reconstruct first-source→second-source signed edge per head, project factorial interaction through c_proj. Remove one head interaction, all edge interactions, or full-module interaction at second-source output.
prediction: First-to-second source edge accounts for the L2 second-source factorial interaction. Individual heads may differ in causal output effect; test all9, not only large-norm heads.
limitations: Head decomposition under this parametrization; nonlinear downstream effects need not sum. Reused panel. Removal is a local hybrid intervention, not unique mediation.
